title: freeathome2mqtt channel profile
description: One channel type (docs/03-model-and-profiles.md §3). A profile *file* is a YAML list of these objects; each list element is validated against this schema individually.

id.description: Profile identifier; also the merge key and the value published as `profile`.

functions.description: Which functionIDs (sysap.codes.Function member names) this profile claims.

requires.description: Discriminator when several profiles claim the same function.

parameters.description: Attribute name -> Parameter (sysap.codes.Parameter member name) read once at compile time and attached to the entity.

transform.description: Named escape hatch in model/transforms.py; see docs/03 §7.

attribute.description: attributes.<name> (docs/03 §3.2). Any key beyond the ones listed here is a codec-specific construction parameter, passed to model.codecs.build_codec verbatim (e.g. `scaled`'s `factor`/`offset`) -- deliberately not enumerated since the set is open-ended over the codec registry.

pairing.description: Output pairing (sysap.codes.Pairing member name) to bind to.

values.description: Raw string -> symbolic name. Only meaningful for codec: enum.

default.description: Value when the datapoint is "" or unmapped. Prefer null.

command.description: commands.<name> (docs/03 §3.3). Same open-ended codec_params note as #/$defs/attribute applies.

pairing.description: Input pairing (sysap.codes.Pairing member name) to write.

values.description: Symbolic name -> raw string. The *inverse* direction of the attribute's map (P-03) -- never derive one from the other.

optimistic.description: Attribute name to update optimistically; omit to disable optimism for this command.
